outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD for Tmprss11b normalized counts across mouse models, with individual data points (colored dots) overlaid on each bar.
Panel B is a schematic diagram illustrating the experimental workflow, not a data plot.
Panel C shows representative MRI photographs of mice, not a data plot.
Panel D shows representative H&E micrograph images, not a data plot requiring individual points.
Panel E shows H&E and RNAscope micrograph images with annotated regions, not a data plot.
Panel F shows representative H&E and RNAscope micrograph images, not a data plot.
Panel G shows H&E and RNAscope micrograph images with annotations, not a data plot.
